candidate.title: SUPeR-seq
candidate.scope: The SUPeR-seq row of the supplied Illumina RNA Low-Level Detection schematic, interpreted as the anchored-random-primer SUPeR-seq implementation described by Fan et al. (2015). The upper poly(A)+ and lower non-poly(A) RNA tracks are retained separately as material-provenance paths. They are substrate classes from single-cell RNA, not alternative methods or evidence of separate experimental vessels. The adjacent scRNA-seq and UMI Method rows and the clipped right-hand chemical panel are contextual, not target workflows. The drawn route ends at purified DNA; subsequent TruSeq library preparation and sequencing are a paper-supported interface, not additional depicted operations.

operations.label: Add polyA primer with T7 promoter and PCR target
operations.description: Add anchored primers to the poly(A)+ RNA track, yielding primer-associated RNA at multiple depicted sites. The caption is literal; the primary-paper-supported reagent identity is AnchorX-T15N6, not an established T7-promoter component.

operations.label: Reverse transcription and primer digestion with ExoSAP-IT
operations.description: Convert the primed poly(A)+ RNA representation into first-strand cDNA and remove excess primers. The output icon also has an AAAAA tract and a complementary orange-ended poly(T) primer. The primary paper resolves these as post-RT cDNA tailing and second-strand priming; the caption compresses these transitions.
operations.mechanism: Reverse transcription copies RNA into first-strand cDNA; ExoSAP-IT digests unreacted primers. The paper resolves the drawn new A tract as TdT-added poly(A) at the cDNA 3′ end, with ddATP limiting extension; AnchorY-T24 supplies the tail-bound second-strand primer. Completion of the second strand precedes PCR at the next interface.
operations.information_effect: The physical carrier changes from RNA to a DNA copy. Artificial cDNA tailing supplies a second priming interface for either source RNA class; it does not establish that the original RNA was polyadenylated.

method_scopes.rationale: All operation instances belong only to the SUPeR-seq row. The paired instances preserve the upper poly(A)+ and lower non-poly(A) material tracks under common captions; this does not assert experimental separation, a pooling step, or two methods. The matching catalogue heading identifies the same SUPeR-seq target. Fan et al. explicitly establish the anchored-random-primer implementation for both RNA classes and resolve the cDNA-tailing/second-strand interface. The final DNA carries copies of sampled RNA sequences, allowing transcript detection and abundance estimates after sequencing; circRNA identity requires reads across a reversed-order exon junction. The figure does not itself depict sequencing, junction analysis, native RNA end measurement, or complete coverage of all cellular RNAs.
